recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The current FHIR core source matches the published work-group decision not to collapse product-definition resources. Revisit only if new implementation evidence leads BR&R to reopen the resource-boundary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-28581 requested merging MedicinalProductDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, and PackagedProductDefinition concepts into one reusable product-definition resource with profiles for the IDMP views. It was resolved Published / Not Persuasive with Modification for R5; the work group was not convinced by the arguments and stated that the resource definitions had been enhanced to explain the selected boundaries.
initial_application: No original source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-28581 was found. Current application appears through related medication-definition documentation work: the module page added simpler and one-resource guidance and rationale against a generic profiled product resource, while FHIR#31805 commits added contained-resource and package guidance. A related AutoFHIR FHIR-31863 commit already corrected stale package relationship wording in that guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-31863 is the same resource-boundary change family and was also Published / Not Persuasive with Modification, reinforcing that improved documentation rather than model collapse was the accepted path. BR&R minutes list FHIR-28581 and FHIR-31863 as the remaining Medication Definition in-person negatives before final resolution. Zulip discussion shows the same debate over one-resource/profile alternatives versus distinct resources for complex package, manufactured-item, and administrable-product use cases.
reconciliation: No source change was made. In current build scope, fhir.ini lists the relevant product-definition resources as active/normative, and the module and resource Scope and Usage source already explain the boundary rationale, simpler one-resource representations, contained-resource option, packageFor relationship, administrable-product role, and package role.

related_jiras.note: Independently challenged medication-definition product resource boundaries and was resolved by retaining distinct resources with improved documentation; already represented on the combined branch.
Added contained-resource and recursive package guidance that helps explain how simpler use cases can avoid unnecessary separate resource instances while retaining distinct resource types.
Audited MedicationKnowledge scope documentation, relevant background for the MedicationKnowledge versus Medication Definition boundary raised in the seed discussion.
Audited administrable route simplification, relevant background for one aspect of the MedicinalProductDefinition versus AdministrableProductDefinition split.
